Indian Army Undergoing Major Transformation for Future Warfare

The Indian Army is implementing significant structural changes to prepare for future conflicts, focusing on technology integration and agile combat units. Key initiatives include the formation of Integrated Battle Groups (IBGs) and specialized drone units, alongside advancements in armoured vehicle technology. These reforms aim to enhance combat readiness and adapt to evolving geopolitical landscapes.
